evidence.title: Gruesome injuries throw spotlight on France’s policing of high school protests

occurrences.checkable_against: Eden's medical records and mother's statement
occurrences.quote_span: But when she then called him, it was one of his classmates who answered, screaming that her son had been hit in the face and was on the ground, bleeding with his jaw and top teeth broken and bottom teeth “completely ripped out,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: mother of Eden
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: Eden's video and mother's statement
occurrences.quote_span: The boy, Eden, sent his mother a video from outside his school, showing police and some protesters, just moments before the officer shot him with the gas grenade, she said, speaking to The Associated Press and other media on condition that she not be identified to preserve the anonymity of her child.
occurrences.speaker: mother of Eden
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: French judicial investigation docket and police disciplinary records
occurrences.quote_span: Suspended from duty and barred from carrying a gun, he is the first officer facing potential prosecution in 18 investigations opened so far into suspected police misconduct during the protests.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: French prosecutor's office charging and custody records
occurrences.quote_span: The officer who fired it was taken into custody a week later and charged with violent mutilation, punishable by up to 15 years in prison.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: French prosecutor's office charging record
occurrences.quote_span: It described the officer’s actions as disproportionate, resulting in a preliminary charge against him of violence by a public official causing mutilation or permanent disability.
occurrences.speaker: French prosecutor's office
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: Injured boy's medical records and mother's statement
occurrences.quote_span: Following surgery, the boy cannot speak and can only eat with a straw, his mother says.
occurrences.speaker: mother of the injured 14-year-old
occurrences.subject: French policeman

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecutor's office statement and custody interrogation record
occurrences.quote_span: In the case of the 14-year-old with a smashed jaw and teeth, the officer who fired his grenade launcher directly at him during a protest in Saint-Ouen l’Aumone, northwest of Paris, said during questioning in custody that he acted in “a fraction of a second” to protect a female colleague who’d exchanged blows with the boy, according to a statement from the prosecutor’s office leading the investigation.
occurrences.speaker: French prosecutor's office
occurrences.subject: French policeman
